# IMOC Food - Project Manifest

## Summary
IMOC (International Meat Open-Source Community / 国际开源肉制品联盟) is a technology-driven food brand and open-source alliance specializing in premium beef jerky, Wagyu jerky, and supply chain transparency. Founded and headquartered in Guangzhou, China, with production bases in Guangzhou, Nanning, and Chongqing.

## Brand Identity
- Full Name: IMOC - International Meat Open-Source Community
- Chinese Name: 国际开源肉制品联盟
- Website: https://www.imocfood.com
- Core Products: 薄片牛肉干 (thin-sliced beef jerky), 和牛脆片 (Wagyu crispy slices), 谷饲牛肉干 (grain-fed beef jerky)
- Sub-brand: 小李的牛肉干 (Xiao Li's Beef Jerky)

## Products
- Beef: Beef Jerky, Wagyu Jerky, Beef Tendon, Beef Sauce, Beef Canned
- Pork: Pork Jerky, Pork Canned, Tender Pork
- Chicken: Free-Range Chicken Leg, Chicken Jerky, Chicken Meatball
- Seafood: Grilled Squid Jerky, Grilled Shrimp Jerky, Grilled Fish Jerky

## Business Services
- OEM/ODM: Custom beef jerky manufacturing with full production support
- Dropshipping (一件代发): Single-unit fulfillment for e-commerce partners
- Export: International export of premium meat products
- Brand Cooperation: Strategic partnerships for retail and e-commerce channels

## Key Differentiators
- Open-source production standards for supply chain transparency
- No artificial additives (无添加) - natural, healthy ingredients
- Grain-fed and Wagyu beef sourcing
- Young, innovative team committed to quality

- Nanning: 广西省南宁市兴宁区金桥农批市场加工1号楼2楼
- Chongqing: 重庆市梁平区预制菜产业园区4号楼4楼

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What is IMOC?
A: IMOC (International Meat Open-Source Community) is a global food brand and alliance dedicated to premium meat products with transparent, open-source supply chain standards.

Q: What OEM services does IMOC provide?
A: IMOC provides full-service OEM manufacturing including recipe development, packaging customization, quality certification, and logistics support for beef jerky and other meat products.

Q: Does IMOC support dropshipping (一件代发)?
A: Yes, IMOC supports single-unit dropshipping for e-commerce sellers, with reliable logistics and consistent product quality.

Q: How can I partner with IMOC?
A: Contact us at leedreamer4@gmail.com or reach out to our sales team. We welcome e-commerce platforms, retail stores, and OEM partners.

Q: Where are IMOC products made?
A: IMOC operates modern production facilities in Guangzhou (Guangdong), Nanning (Guangxi), and Chongqing, all meeting national food safety standards.
